name: Phone Harness
tagline: Control iPhone and Android devices from code via an API
description: Phone Harness provides an API that lets software agents interact with real iPhones and Android phones. Agents can tap, type, scroll, and read screen content using vision OCR or the accessibility tree. The service offers shared Android emulators and cloud iPhones on a flat subscription. New users receive $5 of credit for Android usage. It supports live viewing, persistent login state, and unlimited concurrent devices. The platform is useful for developers building AI agents, automating mobile workflows, testing apps, and handling SMS or 2FA without installing apps on the device.
best_for: Running AI agents that need phone interaction
Automating SMS and two‑factor authentication flows
Gathering data from mobile app interfaces
Providing virtual phone numbers for agents

free_tier.notes: Credit applies to Android emulators at 5¢ per minute
